### CHECK 约束

- <code>finance_facts_amount_positive</code>

```sql
amount > 0
```

- <code>finance_facts_cancel_audit_bundle</code>

```sql
(
  (status = 'CANCELLED'
    AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancel_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)
  OR
  (status <> 'CANCELLED'
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL)
)
```

- <code>finance_facts_collection_type_allowed</code>

```sql
collection_type IS NULL OR collection_type IN ('ADVANCE_RECEIPT', 'ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE')
```

- <code>finance_facts_counterparty_allowed</code>

```sql
counterparty_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'SUPPLIER', 'OTHER')
```

- <code>finance_facts_currency_allowed</code>

```sql
currency IN ('USD', 'CNY', 'HKD')
```

- <code>finance_facts_fee_amount_nonnegative</code>

```sql
fee_amount >= 0
```

- <code>finance_facts_invoice_category_allowed</code>

```sql
invoice_category IS NULL OR invoice_category IN ('NONE', 'EXPORT_GENERAL', 'VAT_GENERAL_1', 'VAT_SPECIAL_3', 'VAT_SPECIAL_13')
```

- <code>finance_facts_payment_term_allowed</code>

```sql
payment_term IS NULL OR payment_term IN ('CASH_ON_SHIPMENT', 'EOM_30', 'EOM_45')
```

- <code>finance_facts_payment_term_days_check</code>

```sql
payment_term_days IS NULL OR payment_term_days >= 0
```

- <code>finance_facts_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('DRAFT', 'POSTED', 'SETTLED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>finance_facts_status_audit_bundle</code>

```sql
(
  (status = 'DRAFT'
    AND posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL
    AND settled_at IS NULL AND settled_by IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'POSTED'
    AND posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL
    AND settled_at IS NULL AND settled_by IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'SETTLED'
    AND posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL
    AND settled_at IS NOT NULL AND settled_by IS NOT NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'CANCELLED'
    AND settled_at IS NULL AND settled_by IS NULL
    AND ((posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL)
      OR (posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL)))
)
```

- <code>finance_facts_type_allowed</code>

```sql
fact_type IN ('RECEIVABLE', 'PAYABLE', 'INVOICE', 'RECONCILIATION')
```

- <code>finance_facts_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

## `finance_payments` — 收付款单

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存收款或付款的登记、审批、过账、账户凭据和金额。 |
| 明确不负责 | 审批只改变单据阶段；只有显式过账事务才创建核销分配，Workflow done 不等于 payment POSTED。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | DRAFT 可经 ProcessRuntime 转 APPROVED 或 REJECTED；DRAFT 或受控 APPROVED 可 CANCELLED；APPROVED 可 POSTED；POSTED 可 REVERSED；不物理删除。 |
| 写入边界 | OperationalFactUsecase 创建、取消和冲正；审批、拒绝与过账通过 ProcessRuntime 白名单领域命令执行。 |
| Catalog 敏感字段 | <code>account_ref</code>, <code>evidence_ref</code> |
| 审查备注 | clean schema 明确称其为 accounting source document；已过账收付款与不可变核销事实由 finance_allocations 分层承接。 |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>finance_payments_amount_positive</code>

```sql
amount > 0
```

- <code>finance_payments_counterparty_allowed</code>

```sql
counterparty_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'SUPPLIER')
```

- <code>finance_payments_currency_allowed</code>

```sql
currency IN ('USD', 'CNY', 'HKD')
```

- <code>finance_payments_direction_allowed</code>

```sql
direction IN ('RECEIPT', 'DISBURSEMENT')
```

- <code>finance_payments_direction_party_pair</code>

```sql
((direction = 'RECEIPT' AND counterparty_type = 'CUSTOMER') OR (direction = 'DISBURSEMENT' AND counterparty_type = 'SUPPLIER'))
```

- <code>finance_payments_intent_bundle</code>

```sql
length(trim(idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(idempotency_payload_hash) = 64
```

- <code>finance_payments_lifecycle_audit</code>

```sql
(
  (status = 'DRAFT'
    AND approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL
    AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL
    AND posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL
    AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'APPROVED'
    AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by IS NOT NULL
    AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL
    AND posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL
    AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'REJECTED'
    AND approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL
    AND rejected_at IS NOT NULL AND rejected_by IS NOT NULL
    AND reject_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reject_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255
    AND posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL
    AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'POSTED'
    AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by IS NOT NULL
    AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL
    AND posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL
    AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'REVERSED'
    AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by IS NOT NULL
    AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL
    AND posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL
    AND reversed_at IS NOT NULL AND reversed_by IS NOT NULL
    AND reverse_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reverse_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)
  OR
  (status = 'CANCELLED'
    AND (
      (approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL
        AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL)
      OR
      (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by IS NOT NULL
        AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL)
      OR
      (approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL
        AND rejected_at IS NOT NULL AND rejected_by IS NOT NULL
        AND reject_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reject_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)
    )
    AND posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancel_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255
    AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
)
```

- <code>finance_payments_maker_checker</code>

```sql
approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> created_by
```

- <code>finance_payments_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'POSTED', 'REVERSED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>finance_payments_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

## `rework_intakes` — 返工回厂单

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存已出货产品返工回厂的来源出货、客户快照、返工原因、接收状态和审计信息。 |
| 明确不负责 | 返工回厂不是商业退货、退款或换货；只有 RECEIVED 才由受控事务创建 HOLD 库存，Workflow done 不替代接收。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | DRAFT 可转 RECEIVED 或 CANCELLED；RECEIVED 可转 REVERSED；不物理删除。 |
| 写入边界 | OperationalFactUsecase 创建、接收、取消和冲正返工回厂聚合。 |

### 字段

| 字段 | PostgreSQL 类型 | Ent 类型 | NULL | 数据库默认值 | 结构属性 | 说明 |

| 索引 | 唯一 | 字段 | Predicate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>reworkintake_created_by_idempotency_key</code> | 是 | <code>created_by</code>, <code>idempotency_key</code> | — |
| <code>reworkintake_customer_id_status</code> | 否 | <code>customer_id</code>, <code>status</code> | — |
| <code>reworkintake_intake_no</code> | 是 | <code>intake_no</code> | — |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>rework_intakes_intent_bundle</code>

```sql
length(trim(idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(idempotency_payload_hash) = 64 AND idempotency_item_count > 0
```

- <code>rework_intakes_lifecycle_audit</code>

```sql
(
  (status = 'DRAFT'
    AND received_at IS NULL AND received_by IS NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL
    AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'RECEIVED'
    AND received_at IS NOT NULL AND received_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL
    AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'CANCELLED'
    AND received_at IS NULL AND received_by IS NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancel_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255
    AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'REVERSED'
    AND received_at IS NOT NULL AND received_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL
    AND reversed_at IS NOT NULL AND reversed_by IS NOT NULL
    AND reverse_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reverse_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)
)
```

- <code>rework_intakes_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('DRAFT', 'RECEIVED', 'CANCELLED', 'REVERSED')
```

- <code>rework_intakes_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

## `shipments` — 出货单

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存销售交付或返工补发的来源单、财务放行状态和显式出货时间。 |
| 明确不负责 | 销售交付必须取得财务放行；返工补发必须关联返工回厂单且财务状态为 NOT_REQUIRED；只有 SHIPPED 才写库存 OUT。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | DRAFT 转 SHIPPED；DRAFT 可 CANCELLED，SHIPPED 通过 REVERSAL 后转 CANCELLED；销售交付使用 PENDING、APPROVED、REJECTED，返工补发固定 NOT_REQUIRED；不删除。 |
| 写入边界 | OperationalFactUsecase 创建、出货和取消；销售交付的财务放行及正式出货可由 ProcessRuntime 白名单命令驱动。 |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>shipments_finance_release_status_allowed</code>

```sql
finance_release_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'NOT_REQUIRED')
```

- <code>shipments_finance_release_version_positive</code>

```sql
finance_release_version > 0
```

- <code>shipments_purpose_allowed</code>

```sql
purpose IN ('SALES_DELIVERY', 'REWORK_RESHIPMENT')
```

- <code>shipments_purpose_source_bundle</code>

```sql
((purpose = 'SALES_DELIVERY' AND rework_intake_id IS NULL AND finance_release_status <> 'NOT_REQUIRED') OR (purpose = 'REWORK_RESHIPMENT' AND rework_intake_id IS NOT NULL AND sales_order_id IS NULL AND finance_release_status = 'NOT_REQUIRED'))
```

- <code>shipments_requested_total_net_weight_g_positive</code>

```sql
requested_total_net_weight_g IS NULL OR requested_total_net_weight_g > 0
```

- <code>shipments_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('DRAFT', 'SHIPPED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>shipments_total_net_weight_g_positive</code>

```sql
total_net_weight_g IS NULL OR total_net_weight_g > 0
```
